description.value: Small Victory Bakery is a family-owned neighborhood bakery and cafe whose founders grew up in a family baking business started by Kenyan immigrant parents on West Broadway. The Mount Pleasant location on West 6th Avenue specializes in artisan breads, laminated pastries, and specialty coffee sourced from local roasters. A full brunch and lunch menu rounds out the offering, making it a worthwhile stop for cyclists wanting a proper sit-down meal or fresh bread to carry onward.
